title: Opening: date, location and Ed Allen's birth
summary: Interviewer opens the session and confirms Allen was born in Nashville in December 1897.

blocks.x: Okay, it's January 14th. We're at 195 West 10th Street and I'm talking to Ed Allen. Now Ed, the only thing I know about your early career is what it says on the back of this record. You were born in Nashville, Tennessee, December 15th, 1897. Is that right? Yeah, that's right.
